admissionPolicy.zh: 候选记录不是正式收录。只有权威来源、许可与再分发、完整契约、传输协议、安全审查以及 SDK/CLI 发布六个门槛全部通过后，产品才可进入 catalog/source.json。完整产品边界包含 SSE 或其他当前不支持的实时协议时，整集暂缓，不得裁剪发布。
admissionPolicy.en: Candidate records are not catalog admission. A product may enter catalog/source.json only after authoritative sourcing, redistribution, complete-contract, transport, safety, and SDK/CLI publication gates all pass. If the complete product boundary contains SSE or another currently unsupported realtime protocol, the whole collection is deferred rather than published as a subset.

boundary.zh: Notion 当前版本化公共 API，覆盖页面、区块、数据源、数据库、评论、文件上传、视图、用户、搜索、OAuth 与 webhook 管理。
boundary.en: The current versioned Notion public API covering pages, blocks, data sources, databases, comments, file uploads, views, users, search, OAuth, and webhook management.

blockers.zh: 尚未找到由 Notion 发布的单一完整 OpenAPI 快照；需把当前版本官方参考与官方 SDK 类型逐接口对账。
blockers.en: No single complete OpenAPI snapshot published by Notion has been identified; the current reference and official SDK types still need endpoint-by-endpoint reconciliation.

blockers.zh: Notion Developer Terms 第 3.1 条禁止复制、展示或向第三方分发 API；官方 SDK 的 MIT 许可证不授权发布完整 API metadata、重建 OAS 或独立生成客户端。需取得 Notion 的书面再分发许可。
blockers.en: Section 3.1 of the Notion Developer Terms prohibits copying, displaying, or distributing the API to third parties. The official SDK's MIT license does not authorize publication of complete API metadata, a reconstructed OAS, or an independently generated client; written redistribution permission from Notion is required.

nextAction.zh: 在 Notion 书面授予 API metadata、重建规范与独立生成客户端的发布/再分发许可后，固定 Notion-Version 2026-03-11，导出官方 CLI/SDK 的完整 Endpoint 清单并完成协议审查。
nextAction.en: After Notion grants written publication and redistribution permission for API metadata, a reconstructed specification, and an independently generated client, pin Notion-Version 2026-03-11, export the complete official CLI/SDK endpoint inventory, and complete transport review.

boundary.zh: WPS 365 统一 OpenAPI 产品面，包含通讯录、云文档、消息、会议、日历、智能文档及事件订阅；已确认事件订阅采用加密 HTTP callback，其他由供应商定义的协议面仍待完整盘点。
boundary.en: The supplier-defined WPS 365 unified OpenAPI surface, including contacts, cloud documents, messaging, meetings, calendars, smart documents, and event subscriptions; event delivery is confirmed to use encrypted HTTP callbacks, while the remaining supplier-defined transport surface still requires a complete inventory.

blockers.zh: 官方说明产品面超过 1,000 个接口，但未发现可公开下载、可复现的完整规范快照。
blockers.en: The official overview says the product surface exceeds 1,000 endpoints, but no publicly downloadable and reproducible complete specification snapshot has been identified.

blockers.zh: 需确认 OpenAPI metadata 与生成客户端的发布、再分发和署名条件。
blockers.en: Publication, redistribution, and attribution terms for OpenAPI metadata and generated clients still require confirmation.

blockers.zh: 事件订阅已确认使用加密 HTTP callback，但其余 1,000 多个接口的完整协议面仍待逐项盘点，暂不能确认不存在其他实时或不受支持的传输协议。
blockers.en: Event subscriptions are confirmed to use encrypted HTTP callbacks, but the complete transport surface across the remaining 1,000-plus endpoints still requires inventory before other realtime or unsupported protocols can be ruled out.

nextAction.zh: 向 WPS 获取官方完整规范或书面授权，并盘点全部版本、区域、认证、权限和协议面。
nextAction.en: Obtain the complete official specification or written authorization from WPS, then inventory all versions, regions, authentication, permissions, and transports.

boundary.zh: MongoDB Atlas Administration API v2；不包含 MongoDB wire protocol、Atlas Data API 或其他独立产品。
boundary.en: MongoDB Atlas Administration API v2 only; it excludes the MongoDB wire protocol, Atlas Data API, and other separately defined products.

contractSource.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US (the pinned OAS info.license; repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0 but does not resolve the OAS-specific restriction)

blockers.zh: 已固定的官方 OAS 在 info.license 中声明 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US。仓库根 LICENSE 为 Apache-2.0，但未将该许可证覆盖到 OAS；在 MongoDB 提供书面澄清或可商用再分发的 OAS 版本前，不能发布完整 metadata 或独立生成的 npm SDK。
blockers.en: The pinned official OAS declares CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US in info.license. The repository root LICENSE is Apache-2.0 but does not extend that license to the OAS; complete metadata or an independently generated npm SDK cannot be published until MongoDB provides written clarification or a commercially redistributable OAS revision.

blockers.zh: 管理面包含删除集群、网络与访问配置等高影响写接口，需完成 Endpoint 级 preview/confirmation 与代理禁用策略。
blockers.en: The administration surface contains high-impact mutations for clusters, networking, and access configuration; endpoint-level preview/confirmation and proxy-disable policy are still required.

blockers.zh: 规范可生成，但 @pontx/mongodb-atlas-admin 与 pontx-mongodb-atlas-admin 尚未构建、测试和发布。
blockers.en: The contract is generation-ready, but @pontx/mongodb-atlas-admin and pontx-mongodb-atlas-admin have not been built, tested, and published.

nextAction.zh: 先取得 MongoDB 对 OAS 与独立生成客户端的书面可商用再分发澄清，或固定一个明确许可的 OAS 版本；随后再完成双语 prose、敏感 Endpoint 执行策略与 SDK/CLI 发布链路。
nextAction.en: First obtain MongoDB's written clarification permitting commercial redistribution of the OAS and independently generated client, or pin an explicitly licensed OAS revision; then complete bilingual prose, sensitive-endpoint execution policy, and the SDK/CLI release chain.

boundary.zh: PostHog 官方托管实例公开的完整 Public API schema；不按 Explinks 的数据仓库子集裁剪。
boundary.en: The complete Public API schema exposed by an official PostHog hosted instance, not the narrower data-warehouse subset shown by Explinks.

blockers.zh: 官方完整 schema 含多个 text/event-stream / SSE Endpoint；按原子暂缓规则整集阻断。
blockers.en: The complete official schema contains multiple text/event-stream/SSE endpoints, so the whole collection is blocked by the atomic transport hold.

blockers.zh: 完整 schema 混合核心与企业能力，需确认各路径适用的 MIT/企业许可及规范再分发条件。
blockers.en: The complete schema mixes core and enterprise capabilities; applicable MIT/enterprise licensing and specification redistribution terms require review.

blockers.zh: 当前契约来自官方托管实例的可变 schema URL，未固定到可复现的 Git revision，不能作为不可变的完整契约快照。
blockers.en: The current contract comes from a mutable schema URL on an official hosted instance and is not pinned to a reproducible Git revision, so it cannot serve as an immutable complete-contract snapshot.

nextAction.zh: 获取并固定可再分发、可复现的不可变完整 schema 快照，同时实现并验证 SSE 契约支持，再复核混合许可边界。
nextAction.en: Obtain and pin a redistributable, reproducible, immutable snapshot of the complete schema; implement and validate SSE contract support; then re-review the mixed-license boundary.

boundary.zh: Amazon Simple Queue Service 当前官方 API 的 23 个 action、数据类型、错误、区域 Endpoint 与 SigV4 认证。
boundary.en: The current Amazon Simple Queue Service API with all 23 official actions, data types, errors, regional endpoints, and SigV4 authentication.

blockers.zh: DeleteQueue、PurgeQueue、DeleteMessage 与权限变更等接口需高影响 mutation 策略；文档中的 SSE 缩写是 server-side encryption，不是 Server-Sent Events。
blockers.en: DeleteQueue, PurgeQueue, DeleteMessage, and permission mutations require a high-impact execution policy; the SSE acronym in SQS documentation means server-side encryption, not Server-Sent Events.

blockers.zh: 需先从 Smithy 模型生成并发布 @pontx/amazon-sqs 与 pontx-amazon-sqs。
blockers.en: @pontx/amazon-sqs and pontx-amazon-sqs must be generated from the Smithy model, tested, and published first.

nextAction.zh: 建立 Smithy→OpenAPI 的可复现转换，补齐双语说明、SigV4、区域服务器和 mutation 安全策略。
nextAction.en: Create a reproducible Smithy-to-OpenAPI conversion and complete bilingual prose, SigV4, regional servers, and mutation safety policy.

boundary.zh: Dropbox Sign 官方 v3 API 的完整 73 个 Endpoint，包括账户、签名请求、模板、团队、批量发送、文件与 webhook。
boundary.en: The complete official Dropbox Sign v3 API with 73 endpoints across accounts, signature requests, templates, teams, bulk send, files, and webhooks.

nextAction.zh: 持续监控固定上游 revision 之后的 OAS 漂移、Dropbox Sign 安全公告、npm SDK 新鲜安装结果与 Node.js 兼容矩阵；任何结构更新均重新执行完整合同、双语、风险和 SDK 门禁。
nextAction.en: Monitor OAS drift after the pinned upstream revision, Dropbox Sign security notices, fresh npm SDK installation, and the Node.js compatibility matrix; rerun the complete contract, localization, risk, and SDK gates before accepting structural updates.

boundary.zh: Sendbird Chat 服务端 Platform API v3；不包含客户端实时协议、Chat SDK 或 Explinks 连接器抽象。
boundary.en: Sendbird Chat server-side Platform API v3 only; it excludes client realtime protocols, Chat SDKs, and the Explinks connector abstraction.

blockers.zh: 官方生成 SDK 的 package.json 标注 Unlicense，但未找到其完整上游 OpenAPI 源；需将生成代码与官方参考逐 Endpoint 对账。
blockers.en: The official generated SDK package declares Unlicense, but its complete upstream OpenAPI source has not been identified; generated code must be reconciled endpoint by endpoint with the official reference.

blockers.zh: SDK 代码许可明确，但官方文档 prose 与重建规范的再分发条件仍需单独确认。
blockers.en: The SDK code license is explicit, but redistribution of official documentation prose and a reconstructed specification still requires a separate determination.

blockers.zh: 官方概览说明 Platform API 使用 REST/JSON，但仍需对完整服务端边界做非 SSE/实时协议证明。
blockers.en: The official overview describes the Platform API as REST/JSON, but the complete server-side boundary still needs an explicit no-SSE/realtime-protocol audit.

nextAction.zh: 获取官方生成源或供应商确认的规范快照，完成完整 Endpoint/Schema 与传输协议盘点。
nextAction.en: Obtain the official generation source or a supplier-confirmed specification snapshot, then complete the endpoint/schema and transport inventory.

boundary.zh: 欧洲中央银行 Data Portal 当前公开的 SDMX 2.1 REST 数据与结构元数据查询服务；EXR 汇率数据流属于该完整服务面，不单独伪装成供应商级 API。
boundary.en: The current ECB Data Portal SDMX 2.1 REST service for data and structural-metadata queries; the EXR exchange-rate dataflow remains part of this complete service instead of being presented as a separate supplier-level API.

nextAction.zh: 持续复核 ECB 文档、状态码、内容协商、网站信息复用条款与已发布 SDK 的 Node.js 兼容性；发生上游契约变化时先更新双语规范和质量证据。
nextAction.en: Continuously review ECB documentation, status codes, content negotiation, website information reuse terms, and the published SDK's Node.js compatibility; update bilingual contracts and quality evidence before adopting upstream changes.

boundary.zh: Open Exchange Rates 官方 v0.7 JSON REST API，覆盖 latest、historical、currencies、time-series、convert、OHLC 与 usage 七个只读 Endpoint 及官方附加查询参数。
boundary.en: The official Open Exchange Rates v0.7 JSON REST API covering the seven read-only latest, historical, currencies, time-series, convert, OHLC, and usage endpoints plus officially documented query parameters.

derivedProbeFixes: normalized the ReadMe colon date path to an OpenAPI path template
replaced six hyphenated operationIds with code-generation-safe identifiers
removed the generated dangling schemas import because the official OAS declares zero component schemas

blockers.zh: 网站条款保留站点与文档知识产权，只授予不可转让、可撤销的有限使用权；官方 Node wrapper 仓库也没有可识别 LICENSE。尚无证据允许 Pontx 再分发规范 prose 或发布独立生成 SDK。
blockers.en: The website terms reserve site and documentation intellectual property and grant only a non-transferable, revocable, limited right of use; the official Node wrapper repository also has no identifiable LICENSE. No evidence yet authorizes Pontx to redistribute specification prose or publish an independently generated SDK.

blockers.zh: 已从官方 ReadMe 页面内嵌的 document.api.schema 机械提取 7-Endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 快照并固定 SHA-256，但源 URL 可变且机器契约质量未达门槛：0 个 component Schema、4 个成功响应无 Schema、2 个 Endpoint 无 4xx/default、1 个 path template 不合法、6 个 operationId 含连字符而无法直接生成 TypeScript，并且 7 个 Endpoint 均无 Pontx 成功请求示例。2026-08-15 的逐页官方文档审计已足以独立重建 standard-rates、currencies、time-series、OHLC 与 common-error 的 Schema；但 convert 与 usage 仍只描述字段角色而没有可审核的完整成功 payload，且其权限受套餐限制，必须以经授权的 App ID 成功响应或供应商批准 fixture 补齐。
blockers.en: A seven-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 snapshot was mechanically extracted from document.api.schema on the official ReadMe page and pinned by SHA-256, but the mutable machine contract fails quality gates: zero component schemas, four successful responses without schemas, two endpoints without 4xx/default responses, one invalid path template, six hyphenated operationIds that cannot directly generate TypeScript, and no Pontx successful request example on any endpoint. A 2026-08-15 page-by-page audit of official documentation is sufficient to independently reconstruct standard-rates, currencies, time-series, OHLC, and common-error Schemas; convert and usage still describe field roles without an auditable complete success payload, and their plan entitlements require an authorised App ID response or supplier-approved fixture.

blockers.zh: 数据套餐限制基准货币、更新频率、历史/高级能力与再分发权；Hub 代理默认应关闭，调用方必须直接使用自己的 App ID 与数据许可。
blockers.en: Plan entitlements govern base currencies, refresh frequency, historical/advanced features, and redistribution rights; Hub proxying should stay disabled and callers must use their own App ID and data license directly.

blockers.zh: 隔离 RC 在修正 path、6 个 operationId 和生成器空 Schema import 后，可生成 7 个 Endpoint 并通过 TypeScript、ESM/CJS/declarations、CLI build、npm pack dry-run；匿名 currencies SDK/CLI 实调返回 173 种货币。逐页证据可消除其中五类 Schema 的来源缺口，但 convert、usage、套餐约束和七个成功请求示例仍未完成；在此之前不得建立独立 SDK 仓库、CI 或 npm 版本。
blockers.en: After derived fixes for the path, six operationIds, and the generator's empty-schema import, an isolated RC generates seven endpoints and passes TypeScript, ESM/CJS/declarations, CLI build, npm pack dry-run, and anonymous SDK/CLI calls returning 173 currencies. Page-level evidence can close the source gap for five Schema families, but convert, usage, plan constraints, and seven coherent successful request examples remain unfinished; an independent SDK repository, CI, or npm version must not be created first.

nextAction.zh: 继续以官方逐页证据重建七个 Endpoint；同时获取 metadata/独立生成客户端书面发布许可，以及涵盖 convert 和 usage 的经授权 App ID 成功响应或供应商批准 fixture。随后补齐套餐条件、错误与七个成功请求示例，并以代理关闭模式发布 SDK/CLI。
nextAction.en: Continue reconstructing all seven endpoints from official page-level evidence while obtaining written permission to publish metadata and an independently generated client, plus authorised App ID success responses or supplier-approved fixtures for convert and usage. Then complete plan conditions, errors, and seven successful request examples before publishing an SDK/CLI with proxying disabled.

boundary.zh: CurrencyBeacon 官方 v1 REST API，覆盖 latest、historical、convert、timeseries 与 currencies 五个只读 Endpoint；供应商另行提供的 MCP server 不并入 REST 集合。
boundary.en: The official CurrencyBeacon v1 REST API covering the five read-only latest, historical, convert, timeseries, and currencies endpoints; the separately offered MCP server is not merged into this REST collection.

pontxProbe.reason: Generating a five-method SDK would require invented historical, timeseries, and currencies response schemas and would violate the complete-contract gate.
pontxProbe.thirdPartyDiscovery: The APIs.io link now points to a changed API Evangelist repository with split third-party specs and no identifiable LICENSE; it is not authoritative contract evidence.

blockers.zh: 条款允许在应用中展示返回数据并要求署名，但同时禁止转售、再分发服务和将产品用于其他产品/服务，且没有规范或 SDK 代码许可；需供应商书面确认 metadata 与独立生成客户端发布权。
blockers.en: The terms allow returned data to be reproduced in applications with attribution, but also prohibit reselling, service redistribution, and use of the product within other products/services, with no specification or SDK-code license; supplier confirmation is required for metadata and independently generated client publication.

blockers.zh: 官方页面确认 v1 的五个 Endpoint、两种鉴权和 401/403/404/429/500，但只给 latest 与 convert 两个完整成功示例。2026-08-15 的官方代码样例额外确认 historical 与 timeseries 的 `response.rates` 路径、currencies 的 `response` 路径，以及 timeseries 的 symbols/start_date/end_date 请求形状；这些不是完整成功 Schema，仍缺少完整字段、required/nullable、约束和套餐差异。匿名 currencies 实测确认 401 error envelope，但不能证明成功 Schema。第三方 APIs.io 链接已经失效，当前 API Evangelist 拆分规范没有 LICENSE 且不是供应商证据，因此不能据此声称完整契约。
blockers.en: The official pages confirm five v1 endpoints, two authentication methods, and 401/403/404/429/500 statuses, but provide complete success examples only for latest and convert. Official code samples re-audited on 2026-08-15 additionally confirm the `response.rates` paths for historical and timeseries, the `response` path for currencies, and the timeseries symbols/start_date/end_date request shape; these are not complete success Schemas and still omit the full fields, required/nullable semantics, constraints, and plan differences. An anonymous currencies check confirms the 401 error envelope but not its success schema. The third-party APIs.io link is stale, while the current split API Evangelist specs have no LICENSE and are not supplier evidence, so they cannot establish a complete contract.

blockers.zh: 条款要求署名并限制缓存返回数据超过八小时；正式 SDK 与 Hub 必须把凭证留在调用方，并默认禁用代理、缓存与数据持久化。
blockers.en: The terms require attribution and limit caching returned data beyond eight hours; a formal SDK and Hub integration must keep credentials caller-side and disable proxying, caching, and data persistence by default.

blockers.zh: 按质量门停止了代码生成：若现在生成五方法 SDK，historical、timeseries 和 currencies 的返回值只能是 any 或臆造 Schema，无法满足用户要求的完整契约。还需解决 CLI 对 api_key/Bearer 凭证的环境注入与脱敏，再建立独立仓库、CI 和 npm 版本。
blockers.en: Code generation was intentionally stopped at the quality gate: a five-method SDK would expose historical, timeseries, and currencies as any or depend on invented schemas, contrary to the requested complete contract. Environment-only, redacted api_key/Bearer handling must also be solved before an independent repository, CI, and npm version can exist.

nextAction.zh: 继续以官方文档和代码样例核对五个 Endpoint；同时获取完整官方 OAS、版本/变更策略、metadata/SDK 书面发布许可，以及 historical、timeseries、currencies 的供应商批准成功 fixture 或经授权测试密钥。获得后完整建模五个 Endpoint、Bearer/API Key 鉴权、套餐约束、错误和八小时缓存边界。
nextAction.en: Continue reconciling all five endpoints against official documentation and code samples while obtaining a complete official OAS, version/change policy, written metadata/SDK publication permission, and supplier-approved success fixtures or an authorised test key for historical, timeseries, and currencies. Then fully model the five endpoints, Bearer/API-key authentication, plan constraints, errors, and the eight-hour caching boundary.

boundary.zh: Twelve Data 官方 Forex 产品面，包含 REST 实时/历史汇率、换算、时间序列、技术指标以及 WebSocket 实时报价；不把 REST 子集裁剪成完整产品。
boundary.en: The official Twelve Data Forex product surface across REST realtime/historical rates, conversion, time series, technical indicators, and WebSocket realtime quotes; the REST subset is not presented as the complete product.

pontxProbe.credentialFinding: Direct CLI --header and undeclared --apikey inputs were printed and did not authenticate the request; a real release must inject a redacted environment credential in the SDK CLI adapter.

blockers.zh: 官方 Forex 产品明确包含 WebSocket 实时报价。Pontx 已实现注入式 WebSocket runtime、AsyncAPI 3.x 解析、流式类型生成、生成的流式客户端和只读 list streams CLI；生成客户端要求调用方显式提供 URL 与 socket factory，导入时不连接且不生成凭证。Hub 通道/消息文档、凭证安全连接验证和完整 SDK/CLI 端到端验证仍未完成；同时供应商尚未公开两类入站事件的完整 Schema。按协议原子性规则整集仍暂缓。
blockers.en: The official Forex product explicitly includes realtime WebSocket quotes. Pontx now has an injected WebSocket runtime, AsyncAPI 3.x parsing, stream type generation, a generated stream client, and a read-only list-streams CLI; the generated client requires the caller to provide the URL and socket factory explicitly, never connects on import, and never emits credentials. Hub channel/message documentation, credential-safe connection validation, and complete SDK/CLI end-to-end verification remain incomplete; the supplier also has not published complete schemas for either inbound event. The whole collection remains deferred under the atomic transport rule.

blockers.zh: 条款把 API、SDK、文档和市场数据列为供应商财产，默认仅授权内部使用；外部展示或再分发需要相应套餐、附加许可或书面协议，免费层禁止商业使用。metadata 与独立 SDK 发布范围仍需确认。
blockers.en: The terms identify APIs, SDKs, documentation, and market data as supplier property and default access to internal use; external display or redistribution requires the applicable tier, add-on, or written agreement, and free-tier data cannot be used commercially. Metadata and independently generated SDK publication rights remain unresolved.

blockers.zh: 已找到官方可下载的 REST OpenAPI 3.1.0：187 个 Endpoint、797 个 Schema，所有 operationId 唯一，成功/错误响应均有 Schema，并可原样通过 Pontx 代码生成。官方 SDK 和支持文档已证明 WebSocket URL、四种出站事件和两种入站事件名，但未发布 subscribe-status 或 price 的完整入站 payload Schema；REST URL 仍可变、没有 OAS 许可声明，并缺少 187 个 Pontx 成功请求示例，因此仍不是完整产品契约。
blockers.en: The official downloadable REST OpenAPI 3.1.0 has 187 endpoints, 797 schemas, unique operationIds, schema-backed success/error responses, and successful raw Pontx generation. The official SDK and support documentation prove the WebSocket URL, four outbound events, and two inbound event names, but publish no complete inbound payload schema for subscribe-status or price; the REST URL remains mutable with no OAS license declaration and all 187 Pontx success-request examples remain absent. This is still not a complete product contract.

blockers.zh: 隔离 REST RC 已从官方 OAS 生成 187 个 Endpoint 与 797 个 Schema，并通过 TypeScript、ESM/CJS/declarations、CLI build、npm pack dry-run和官方 demo SDK/CLI 实调。但 CLI 直接传 header/query 凭证会打印值且没有正确应用 security scheme；验证只能通过不记录凭证的 beforeRequest demo adapter 完成。正式发布仍受 WebSocket、许可、双语 metadata、凭证红线、独立仓库/CI/npm 版本阻断。
blockers.en: An isolated REST RC generated 187 endpoints and 797 schemas from the official OAS and passed TypeScript, ESM/CJS/declarations, CLI build, npm pack dry-run, and official-demo SDK/CLI calls. Direct CLI header/query credentials were printed and did not correctly apply the security scheme, so validation required a non-logging beforeRequest demo adapter. A release remains blocked on WebSocket coverage, licensing, bilingual metadata, credential safety, and an independent repository/CI/npm version.

nextAction.zh: 完成 Hub 通道/消息文档、绝不记录凭证的连接验证和完整 SDK/CLI 端到端验证；并向 Twelve Data 获取完整、固定的 WebSocket 入站 Schema/fixture 以及 metadata、SDK 与外部展示/再分发许可。随后对 REST、WebSocket、套餐、市场数据与缓存边界做整体准入审查。
nextAction.en: Finish Hub channel/message documentation, connection validation that never records credentials, and complete SDK/CLI end-to-end verification; obtain complete pinned WebSocket inbound schemas/fixtures plus metadata, SDK, and external-display/redistribution permission from Twelve Data. Then review REST, WebSocket, plan, market-data, and caching boundaries as one admission unit.

boundary.zh: OpenAI Platform 当前公开 REST、流式与实时 API 的完整供应商产品面。
boundary.en: The complete current OpenAI Platform product surface across public REST, streaming, and realtime APIs.

blockers.zh: Responses、图像、音频等产品面包含 Server-Sent Events，另有 Realtime 协议；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: The Responses, image, audio, and other surfaces include Server-Sent Events, with an additional Realtime protocol; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 等待 Pontx 完整支持并验证 SSE/Realtime 契约后重审。
nextAction.en: Re-review after Pontx fully supports and validates SSE and Realtime contracts.

boundary.zh: 阿里云百炼提供的 Qwen 供应商级 API 产品面，模型版本不拆分为独立集合。
boundary.en: The supplier-level Qwen API surface provided by Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; model versions are not split into separate collections.

blockers.zh: 官方流式输出基于 SSE，且部分 Qwen 模型只支持流式调用；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: Official streaming uses SSE, and some Qwen models are streaming-only; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 实现 SSE 后重新盘点百炼原生协议、OpenAI 兼容协议、区域与模型边界。
nextAction.en: After SSE support lands, re-inventory native Model Studio, OpenAI-compatible, regional, and model boundaries.

boundary.zh: DeepSeek 官方 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 的完整产品面，模型别名与版本不拆分。
boundary.en: The complete official DeepSeek API surface across its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible formats; model aliases and versions are not split.

blockers.zh: 官方 Chat 与 FIM 接口以 text/event-stream 返回增量消息；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: The official Chat and FIM endpoints return incremental messages as text/event-stream; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 等待 SSE 契约支持，再固定官方 API 版本与兼容协议范围。
nextAction.en: Wait for SSE contract support, then pin the official API version and compatible-format boundary.

boundary.zh: Google AI for Developers 的完整 Gemini API，包括 Interactions、内容生成、Live、批处理、Embedding、文件与生成式媒体能力。
boundary.en: The complete Gemini API from Google AI for Developers, including Interactions, content generation, Live, batch, embeddings, files, and generative media.

blockers.zh: streamGenerateContent 与 Interactions 使用 SSE，Live API 使用双向实时协议；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: streamGenerateContent and Interactions use SSE, while the Live API uses a bidirectional realtime protocol; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 与双向实时协议均有完整契约支持后重审。
nextAction.en: Re-review only after complete contract support exists for both SSE and bidirectional realtime transports.

boundary.zh: Claude Platform 当前公开的完整 API 产品面，包括 Messages、Files、Batch、工具与管理能力。
boundary.en: The complete current Claude Platform API surface, including Messages, Files, Batch, tools, and administration capabilities.

blockers.zh: Messages API 官方流式响应是带事件类型的 SSE；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: Official Messages API streaming is typed SSE; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 实现 SSE 事件联合类型、错误与未知事件兼容后重审。
nextAction.en: Re-review after SSE event unions, stream errors, and forward-compatible unknown-event handling are supported.

boundary.zh: Kimi 开放平台当前供应商级 API 产品面，Kimi K3、K2.x 与 moonshot-v1 等模型不拆分为集合。
boundary.en: The current supplier-level Kimi Open Platform API surface; Kimi K3, K2.x, moonshot-v1, and other models are not split into separate collections.

blockers.zh: 官方 Chat API 的 stream=true 以 SSE 和 data: [DONE] 返回；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: The official Chat API returns stream=true responses as SSE terminated by data: [DONE]; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 支持后重新固定模型、思考模式与工具调用契约。
nextAction.en: After SSE support lands, re-pin model, thinking-mode, and tool-call contracts.

boundary.zh: 智谱开放平台供应商级 API 产品面；GLM 型号、模态与单个能力页不拆分为集合。
boundary.en: The supplier-level Zhipu Open Platform API surface; GLM model variants, modalities, and individual capability pages are not split into collections.

blockers.zh: 官方流式消息采用 SSE，知识库 Agent 等能力还定义专用 SSE 事件；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: Official streaming messages use SSE, and knowledge-base agent capabilities define additional SSE events; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 支持后盘点模型、知识库、文件、异步任务和区域边界。
nextAction.en: After SSE support lands, inventory model, knowledge-base, file, asynchronous-task, and regional boundaries.

boundary.zh: xAI 当前公开的完整 API 产品面，Grok 模型版本不拆分为集合。
boundary.en: The complete current public xAI API surface; Grok model versions are not split into collections.

blockers.zh: 官方说明所有支持文本输出的模型使用 SSE 流式返回；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: Official documentation states that all text-output-capable models stream using SSE; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 支持后重审完整 Endpoint、许可与版本策略。
nextAction.en: Re-review the complete endpoint, licensing, and versioning surface after SSE support lands.

boundary.zh: 腾讯云混元供应商级 API 产品面，包括生文、生图、Embedding、Token 计数及控制台相关接口。
boundary.en: The supplier-level Tencent Cloud Hunyuan API surface, including text, image, embeddings, token counting, and console APIs.

blockers.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口及原生混元接口包含流式输出，完整协议面尚未通过 SSE/实时筛查；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: The OpenAI-compatible and native Hunyuan surfaces include streaming output and have not passed the complete SSE/realtime audit; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 先确认 TokenHub 迁移后的最终产品边界与全部流式协议，再重审。
nextAction.en: First confirm the post-TokenHub-migration product boundary and every streaming protocol, then re-review.

boundary.zh: 讯飞开放平台星火供应商级 API 产品面，包括通用模型、知识库、工作流、批处理与微调能力。
boundary.en: The supplier-level iFLYTEK Spark API surface across general models, knowledge bases, workflows, batch processing, and fine-tuning.

blockers.zh: 通用模型使用 WebSocket，知识库问答使用 HTTP/SSE，工作流也有流式 HTTP；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: General models use WebSocket, knowledge-base chat uses HTTP/SSE, and workflows also use streaming HTTP; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 WebSocket 与 SSE 契约均支持后重做完整产品盘点。
nextAction.en: Redo the complete product inventory after both WebSocket and SSE contracts are supported.

boundary.zh: 百度智能云千帆供应商级 API 产品面，覆盖模型服务、Agent、应用开发与平台能力。

blockers.zh: 千帆模型与应用调用包含 SSE 流式响应；整集暂缓。
blockers.en: Qianfan model and application invocation surfaces include SSE streaming responses; the whole collection is deferred.

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 支持后，先澄清新旧千帆产品、模型、Agent 与应用 API 的边界。
nextAction.en: After SSE support lands, first reconcile legacy/current Qianfan, model, agent, and application API boundaries.

blockers.zh: Chat/Agent 流式方法、音频转录和 Workflow 事件包含 SSE；整集暂缓。

nextAction.zh: 待 SSE 支持后获取或固定官方 SDK 生成所用 OpenAPI，并复核 Beta/GA 边界。

boundary.zh: Stripe v1 API 中由供应商明确定义的 Identity VerificationSession 与 VerificationReport 资源；不扩展为完整 Stripe 支付集合。
boundary.en: The supplier-defined Identity VerificationSession and VerificationReport resources in Stripe API v1; it does not expand into the complete Stripe payments collection.

nextAction.zh: 持续跟踪固定上游版本与 Stripe Identity 的地区、用途、同意和保留要求；Hub 保持仅文档、零代理，所有调用仅由本地 SDK/CLI 发出。
nextAction.en: Continue tracking the pinned upstream contract and Stripe Identity region, use-case, consent, and retention requirements; keep the Hub documentation-only with zero proxying and execute calls only from the local SDK/CLI.
